items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of workflow definitions configured in the Xceptor platform. Workflows can be filtered by status, category, and name. Each workflow defines a multi-step data processing pipeline.

Creates a new workflow definition in the Xceptor platform. A workflow defines a sequence of processing steps that are executed in order to transform, validate, enrich, and route data through the automation pipeline.
